title: The Broken Hollow
author: Emrys Oyelaran
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
